what_happened.line: The Select Board voted unanimously to accept the assessors' recommendation of a single tax rate for the next fiscal year, after the classification hearing.
The board approved the second quarter FY22 water commitment and a Salvation Army boot drive on December 11th, both by vote.
The board appointed two people to the board of commissioners of trust funds, each until May 2022.
A community kickoff for the old primary school landscape project was set for December 7, with invitations to several town boards.
For the special town meeting, the board agreed to move to pass over articles seven and eight first; the fire union contract's year-one cost comes from the salary reserve.

why_it_matters: A single rate means homes and businesses are taxed at the same rate per thousand dollars of value, so the classification vote bears on how the levy is shared in the tax bill.

The special town meeting warrant is what residents will be asked to vote on, and the board's plan to pass over town hall articles and the fire contract's funding from an existing reserve bear on what reaches that floor.
watch_next: December 7 community kickoff meeting for the old primary school landscape project.
The special town meeting next week, including the passed-over articles and the fire union contract.
